public.title: Object Update
public.description: input has value (object), path (nonempty string-key array), and replacement. All path ancestors exist and are objects. Return the object after replacing the final key, plus original as {updated,original}. The original must remain structurally unchanged. A missing final key is created. Object identity is not observable through JSON. Supported inputs are valid for this contract. Aggregate JSON-serialized input is at most 512 UTF-8 bytes, nesting depth at most 6, arrays at most 40 items, operation/call lists at most 20 items, and individual strings at most 100 ASCII characters unless a tighter bound is stated. Integers have absolute value at most 1000; output arithmetic stays within safe integers. String object keys and string path segments are nonempty safe alphanumeric/underscore names excluding __proto__, constructor and prototype. Empty arrays/objects are allowed where consistent with the contract. Output ordering follows the rules above. These bounds include all nested payloads and all operations together.
hints: Separate the documented JSON representation from the behavior being modeled.
Preserve ordering and distinguish missing values, null, zero and false carefully.

explanation: Copy before writing along the path. This implementation deep-copies O(n) data, so time and auxiliary space are O(n plus path length), and JSON cannot prove reference sharing. Functional tests check the documented adapter behavior; they do not enforce implementation technique or prohibit built-in APIs.
